players.product: Applied HVAC for data centers: medium- and large-capacity chillers, custom air handling units and air-side equipment (Daikin Applied)

quarterly_data.quarter: Daikin Industries annual securities report: FY2026 (06-24-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Fiscal year April 2025 - March 2026: net sales JPY 5,015,036 million (+5.5% YoY), operating profit JPY 414,991 million (+3.3%), ordinary profit JPY 408,171 million (+11.4%), profit attributable to owners of parent JPY 275,229 million (+4.0%). Air Conditioning and Refrigeration Equipment: net sales JPY 4,621,131 million (+5.4%), operating profit JPY 376,991 million (+7.4%); Chemicals: net sales JPY 281,469 million (+7.0%), operating profit JPY 33,089 million (-28.3%, heavily affected by the semiconductor demand slowdown); Other: net sales JPY 112,435 million (+7.3%), operating profit JPY 4,925 million (+8.4%). Management states air conditioning sales grew in businesses with strong demand such as applied and commercial despite lower residential demand in the Americas and China and weak economies and unseasonable weather in Asia
quarterly_data.figure: net sales JPY 5,015,036 million (+5.5%); operating profit JPY 414,991 million (+3.3%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Daikin Industries annual securities report: FY2026 (06-24-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Americas applied air conditioning (FY to March 2026): sales grew by utilizing the chiller factory in Mexico and expanding production capacity at existing factories, together with service business expansion. In the data center field, where market growth continues, sales expanded by leveraging the production capacity added by a new factory starting operation at the custom air handling unit maker, and new acquisitions also contributed; sales exceeded the prior year. In Asia/Oceania the company strengthened applied sales for data centers and other uses

quarterly_data.quarter: Daikin Industries annual securities report: FY2026 (06-24-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Chemicals (FY to March 2026): fluororesin sales were flat as the company focused on capturing strong demand in the new data center field but was hit by weak building and construction markets in the U.S. and China and by channel inventory adjustment for semiconductors; sales of high-performance resins for semiconductor manufacturing equipment declined on the delayed semiconductor demand recovery; fluoroelastomer sales rose on automotive demand in China, Europe and the U.S.; chemical products grew, helped by a newly consolidated site for semiconductor-process etching agents; fluorocarbon gas sales rose on expanded sales in the U.S., Asia and Europe

quarterly_data.quarter: Daikin Industries annual securities report: FY2026 (06-24-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: R&D (FY to March 2026): in North America Daikin developed and launched the large air-cooled screw chiller AWV-C+ series and the large magnetic-bearing chiller WME-QUAD series, using low-GWP refrigerants, for the growing data center market, and is developing large custom air handling units suited to data centers to strengthen combined chiller-plus-air-side offers; in Europe it developed and launched a slim air handling unit for data centers designed for ease of installation and space saving. Chemicals R&D includes heat transfer fluids for data centers and new refrigerants. Group R&D expense JPY 150,756 million (Air Conditioning and Refrigeration JPY 134,097 million, Chemicals JPY 12,823 million, Other JPY 3,834 million)

quarterly_data.quarter: Daikin Industries annual securities report: FY2026 (06-24-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management states the group formulated the strategic management plan FUSION30 (looking to 2030) in 2026, including a transformation into a solutions provider, and positions improving earning power as the top priority for the plan's first year (the company's fiscal 2026, the year after March 2026); that year's themes include pushing sales price policy with stronger sales capability and faster market launches of differentiated products, variable cost reduction, expanding service and solutions profit globally, cutting the fixed cost-to-sales ratio, and raising the profitability of acquired companies
